items.title: Weekly food parcels
items.summary: Fresh and store-cupboard food for local families, packed by volunteers and delivered every Saturday.

items.title: Warm winter meals
items.summary: A hot meal and a warm room three evenings a week from November to March.

items.title: School holiday lunches
items.summary: Packed lunches and activities so children don't go hungry when school is out.
